bodyMarkdown:
## Purpose

One final pointer/value equality assertion; it is a local constraint, not proof of a signed enterprise security profile.

## Constraints and authority

Public schema path: `/composition/locks/*`. The complete selected schema branch and native semantic validator determine admissibility; validate the whole policy, not this value alone. Branch-specific requirements and native permission/identity checks still apply; schema input acceptance alone is not authority. Use synthetic declarations in the preview and keep credential bytes outside policy.

## Expected result

The local proposal contains the intended declaration and passes complete-policy validation. Browser Save retains a local draft; it does not activate native configuration, fetch a provider value or grant remote access. Use the corresponding guide for actual native operations.

## Recovery

On pin, trust, dependency, privacy or equality-lock failure, repair the trusted master/source under its owner. Do not select an unverified cache, discard a lock or upload private fragments to make resolution succeed.
